name: dsh-plugin-watchlist-autobet
description: Paper-only watchlist autobet control plane for sportsdesk-ops: nine Host tools (status/signals/plan/queue/journal plus confirm-gated enqueue, approve/reject, paper execute and settle) and a Web UI operator page with an approval queue, decision tracking, intent context and same-origin control-plane routes. No live order path exists; live betting is not implemented.
